def clean(df):
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.capitalize()
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].astype(float)
    df = df[(df['bill_length_mm'] >= 30) & (df['bill_length_mm'] <= 60)]
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    df = df[df['species'].isin(['Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo'])]
    df = df[df['island'].isin(['Biscoe', 'Dream', 'Torgersen'])]
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().reset_index()
    return dict(zip(df['species'], df['body_mass_g']))
